note: Adds the search.rerank stage (fixed top-N prefix permutation, frozen per list identity), a pinned local ONNX backend, remote /rerank and Synapse backends built off the search path, and the search.rerank config (default off; project tier may only turn it off). With rerank off, which is the default and the benchmark configuration, the ranking path is unchanged, so every ranked row must stay byte-identical to the committed reference. Also keeps bun install's no-change summary in bash output compression, and rolls up aft_inspect's uncovered-file diagnostics gaps by cause with a topK-bounded path list.
